findings_residual.title: Scan::hot()::query() reads scans_cold, not scans_hot - the hot/cold routing has never worked (PRE-EXISTING, wider than DEV-2324)
findings_residual.evidence: Measured in a booted app: Scan::hot()->getTable() = scans_hot, but Scan::hot()::query() resolves to scans_cold (Scan::\$table = 'scans_cold') because \$instance::query() is a STATIC call that discards setTable(); \$hot->newQuery() is the correct idiom and does return scans_hot. This affects the PRE-EXISTING ScanCount::getDescription() and getModelQueryForDates() as well as the getRangeTotal() override added here, which copied the idiom. Net effect for DEV-2324: the card and the chart are now CONSISTENT (both read cold through the same expression), but the override docblock claiming it always reads scans_hot is FALSE.
findings_residual.fix: Repo-wide: replace \$instance::query() with \$instance->newQuery() wherever hot/cold routing is intended, and correct the ScanCount::getRangeTotal() docblock. Pre-existing scope - deserves its own ticket rather than widening this one.

findings_residual.title: getMonthlyData() cache-read amplification (~312 cache reads per render) - carried over from round 1 as a perf follow-up
findings_residual.evidence: These are cache reads, not ClickHouse queries.
findings_residual.fix: Memoize per request in the base class and in both overriding classes (ScanCount, RecoveryLeader).
